article.headline: Kyler Theophile's 18 points help Kennesaw State down Midway 116-57
article.description: — Kyler Theophile had 18 points in Kennesaw State's 116-57 win over Midway on Monday night in a season opener.
article.linkText: Kyler Theophile's 18 points help Kennesaw State down Midway 116-57
article.story: KENNESAW, Ga. -- — Kyler Theophile had 18 points in Kennesaw State's 116-57 win over Midway on Monday night in a season opener. Theophile also had six rebounds for the Owls. Antwane Daniels added 12 points and six assists. C.J. Beaumont had 11 points and shot 4 for 6, including 3 for 4 from beyond the arc. Amari Wales led the way for the Eagles with 16 points, six rebounds and two steals. Sam Parrish added 11 points and. Breland Morrison scored eight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
